==================
Unary plus in case patterns
==================

match foo:
  case +1: ...
  case +1.5 | -1: ...
  case [+1, -2]: ...
  case {+1: a}: ...
---

(module
  (match_statement
    (identifier)
    (block
      (case_clause
        (case_pattern
          (integer))
        (block
          (expression_statement
            (ellipsis))))
      (case_clause
        (case_pattern
          (union_pattern
            (float)
            (integer)))
        (block
          (expression_statement
            (ellipsis))))
      (case_clause
        (case_pattern
          (list_pattern
            (case_pattern
              (integer))
            (case_pattern
              (integer))))
        (block
          (expression_statement
            (ellipsis))))
      (case_clause
        (case_pattern
          (dict_pattern
            (integer)
            (case_pattern
              (dotted_name
                (identifier)))))
        (block
          (expression_statement
            (ellipsis)))))))

==================
Signed complex case patterns
==================

match foo:
  case +1 + 2j: ...
  case -1 - 2j: ...
  case 1 + 2j: ...
---

(module
  (match_statement
    (identifier)
    (block
      (case_clause
        (case_pattern
          (complex_pattern
            (integer)
            (integer)))
        (block
          (expression_statement
            (ellipsis))))
      (case_clause
        (case_pattern
          (complex_pattern
            (integer)
            (integer)))
        (block
          (expression_statement
            (ellipsis))))
      (case_clause
        (case_pattern
          (complex_pattern
            (integer)
            (integer)))
        (block
          (expression_statement
            (ellipsis)))))))
